name: scan-time-preflight
body: The scan driver's preflight: before spawning a language's frontend, it checks that the language's scan-time tools are resolvable on PATH and fails with an actionable error naming the missing tool. The preflight logic is `rust.apg.frontends.scan_time_preflight`, invoked from the frontend spawn path `rust.apg.frontends.spawn_frontend`, which assembles the command and calls `Command::spawn`. `available_languages` probes installed frontend artifacts, a distinct question (artifact present versus toolchain present).
